title: Single Product
description: Spotlights one product as a large card. Use it to feature a single hero product with an optional deal badge and countdown.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: ID of the product to feature. Nothing renders when the product is unavailable in the current shop.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Short label shown above the product, for example "Deal of the day". Leave empty to hide the badge.

high_urgency.title: High Urgency
high_urgency.description: When enabled, the badge and countdown use the high-urgency styling. Defaults to disabled.

background_color.title: Background Color
background_color.description: Card background color using a hex color code. Leave empty for the default background.

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Card text color using a hex color code. Leave empty for the default text color.

show_countdown.title: Show Countdown
show_countdown.description: When enabled, a countdown to the end date is shown on the card. Defaults to disabled.

countdown_end_date.title: Countdown End Date
countdown_end_date.description: Date and time the countdown runs down to. Required for the countdown to appear.
